headline: Unanimous approval of new collective bargaining agreement with Portland Administrators Association.
summary: The contract covers the district's school administrators. Before the vote, the board met in executive session on negotiations with the association. Association leaders said the vote honors administrators' hard work.
decisions: Approved the new collective bargaining agreement with the Portland Administrators Association, unanimously.
discussion: Reading process for contract: The board asked whether a labor contract needs a first and second reading. Labor contracts do not need two readings and can be voted on the same night they come to the board.
Administrator thanks: Speakers praised school building leaders for their work in a challenging climate. An association leader thanked the board for the approval.

decision_evidence.quote: Um, so I would be looking for a motion for that adoption. ... So that motion passes unanimously

decision_titles: Collective bargaining agreement with Portland Administrators Association
